page_title: LOR 2-3 MET | Lorient v Metz 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' It's a throw-in for Metz.
90+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Lorient, play can continue.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Habib Maiga (Metz) for Ablie Jallow.

88' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lorient players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
87' PENALTY APPEAL by Lorient, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
86' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
84' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo will be replaced by Theo Le Bris (Lorient).
84' Substitution. Julien Ponceau (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Tiemoue Bakayoko walks off.
83' 2 - 3 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Ablie Jallow (Metz) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Yvon Mvogo no chance!
82' Ablie Jallow (Metz) is going to take the penalty!
82' Formose Mendy (Lorient) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Metz!
80' Adrian Grbic (Lorient) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort lacks accuracy and goes well out of play.
79' One of the Metz players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
75' Adrian Grbic (Lorient) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
74' Julien Laporte (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
71' Lamine Camara (Metz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
70' Metz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
67' Here is a change. Cheikh Sabaly is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Joel Asoro (Metz).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Simon Elisor trots off the pitch and is replaced by Benjamin Tetteh (Metz).
65' 2 - 2 Ismael Traore (Metz) gets to the ball and glances a sweet header that goes inside the left post!
62' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
60' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bamba Dieng (Lorient) replacing Sirine Doucoure.
60' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Darlin Yongwa and he is replaced by Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eli Junior Kroupi departs the field of play to be replaced by Adrian Grbic (Lorient).
58' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner kick, but Yvon Mvogo reads it well and stops the effort.
57' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) gets a yellow card.
53' The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
53' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Metz.
51' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
50' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
48' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
48' The opposition give Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
48' The resulting free kick from Romain Faivre (Lorient) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
47' Lamine Camara (Metz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Julien Laporte (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. Jeremie Pignard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+2' Romain Faivre (Lorient) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Romain Faivre (Lorient) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' Matthieu Udol (Metz) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
44' Romain Faivre (Lorient) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
43' The free kick from Romain Faivre (Lorient) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
41' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
40' Simon Elisor (Metz) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
38' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
38' A precise low pass is received by Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
37' A corner kick by Metz is thwarted by the well prepared Yvon Mvogo (Lorient).
36' Formose Mendy (Lorient) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexandre Oukidja intercepts the ball.
36' Romain Faivre (Lorient) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
35' A cross from Laurent Abergel (Lorient) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Corner kick. Lorient will have an opportunity.
33' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

32' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but Alexandre Oukidja keeps the ball out.
32' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lorient in a dangerous position.
31' Matthieu Udol (Metz) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
30' The free kick from long range, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' An attempted cross from Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is cleared.
28' A crossfield pass from Matthieu Udol (Metz) fails to find any of his teammates.
27' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.
26' Lamine Camara (Metz) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
25' Simon Elisor (Metz) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
25' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
25' Simon Elisor (Metz) is put clear inside the box by a lofted pass. He only has the keeper to beat, but Yvon Mvogo comes out bravely to save at his feet. Great goalkeeping skills!

22' 2 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Alexandre Oukidja. 2:1.
22' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' The resulting corner from Romain Faivre (Lorient) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Lorient will take a corner.

21' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) strikes from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save. Now Lorient have a corner.
20' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is easily saved by Yvon Mvogo.
19' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
18' Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' The ball is cleared after Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
16' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
15' Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to intercept the corner from Romain Faivre (Lorient).

14' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lorient are going to take it.
13' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) makes a strong challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
12' Romain Faivre (Lorient) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alexandre Oukidja reads it well and gathers the ball.

12' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Lorient force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' The ball is out of play. Metz will have a throw-in.
10' Romain Faivre (Lorient) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
7' 1 - 1 Romain Faivre (Lorient) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
7' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
5' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Montassar Talbi (Lorient) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' Lorient are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Kevin Van Den Kerkhof laid the ball off to Cheikh Sabaly (Metz), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lorient will take the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
